summary:
THE HOLE AT EP 72 CLOSES AS A NEGATIVE, AND THAT IS THE ANSWER: ep 72 animates no scene, beat or page of any manga Act, so it takes no anchor and no start — the A18 crossing (ep 71 END 16 -> ep 73 START 15, END 17) has nothing between it, and no formula should paint one. Under T27 the row is FILLER, not the stored canon, with one loose_parallel tie to Acts 17-18 carried at SLIVER weight.

THE CHAPTER SPACE FIRST, BECAUSE THE ASK'S LABEL IS WRONG. Sailor Moon has TWO act-numbering spaces and ja-WP states both in one infobox line: 話数 = 旧版単行本：全52話 / 新装版・完全版・文庫版：全60話. (a) The ORIGINAL 18-volume tankobon numbers 52 acts: ja-WP's オリジナル版 table (話数は旧単行本より) gives vol 4 = Act13 終結そして始まり / Act14 ブラック・ムーン・コーアン—SAILORMARS / Act15 ブラック・ムーン・ベルチェ—SAILORMERCURY / Act16 ブラック・ムーン・ペッツ—SAILORJUPITER and vol 5 = Act17 ブラックムーン・カラベラス—SAILORVENUS / Act18 タイムワープ—SAILORPLUTO / Act19 クリスタルトーキョー—KING ENDYMION. (b) The RENEWAL numbering (新装版 2003 / 完全版 / 文庫版) numbers 60 acts: Act14 終結 そして 始まり, Act15 侵入—SAILORMARS, Act16 誘拐—SAILORMERCURY, Act17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER, Act18 侵略—SAILORVENUS, Act19 タイム・ワープ—SAILORPLUTO, Act20 クリスタル・トーキョー. OUR STORED SPACE IS (b), THE 60-ACT RENEWAL SPACE — proved three ways: en-WP's 'List of Sailor Moon chapters' prints exactly those renewal titles and numbers and labels the arc 'Black Moon (volumes 4-7/chapters 15-26)', which is the range the ask names; every stored volume boundary matches it (v4 14-17, v5 18-20, v6 21-24, v7 25-27, v8 28-31, v9 32-35, v13 42-43, v14 44-46, v17 53-55, v18 56-60); and the stored anchors sit where only that space puts them (ep 88 -> 26 = 再生—NEVER ENDING, the Black Moon finale; ep 90 -> 27 = 無限1 予感, Infinity's opening; ep 199 -> 59, which does not exist in a 52-act space at all). SO: EVERY NUMBER BELOW IS IN THE 60-ACT RENEWAL SPACE. In the ORIGINAL 52-act space the same acts are one lower in this region (renewal 17 秘密/JUPITER = original 16 ペッツ; renewal 18 侵略/VENUS = original 17 カラベラス) — sailormoon.fandom's own Act 15 page records the shift from the other end ('The original title for this chapter was Act 14 Black Moon Koan - Sailor Mars. In the release of the Manga, the title was Act 15 Shinnyuu SAILOR MARS'). The census line's phrase 'the ORIGINAL 52-act numbering' is a mislabel of the stored space, not a second space in the data; nothing in the catalog needs converting, but the phrase must not be acted on.

ROW IDENTITY (R20). Our row 72 = ja-WP 72（26）「非情のルベウス! 哀しみの四姉妹」10月30日 = en-WP EpisodeNumber 72 / EpisodeNumber3 26, 1993-10-30 = sailormoon.fandom 'ep number 72, season 2, October 30, 1993' = AFL row 72 dated 1993-10-30. Stored title/date need no repair. Joins were by title + date, never index.

WHAT EP 72 ACTUALLY CONTAINS, scene by scene (sailormoon.fandom's Plot section, corroborated by en-WP's summary and by ja-WP's per-character 初代テレビアニメ paragraphs): Wiseman tells Rubeus that only victory or death is left to him and Rubeus answers that he will spend his pawns; at Hikawa Shrine the already-reformed Koan and Berthier rake leaves with Usagi and the guardians over sweet potatoes (Ami and Berthier playing chess, a callback to ep 71); Petz and Calaveras watch through a magic mirror, Rubeus hands Petz the Stick, and the two snatch their 'traitor' sisters; the guardians transform in front of a window through which Chibiusa is watching, and follow to the under-construction Rainbow Bridge; Petz, amplified by the Stick, overpowers Jupiter's Sparkling Wide Pressure with Dark Thunder, dodges Venus Love Me Chain, deflects Burning Mandala and floors all five; she then turns on Calaveras too; Rubeus reveals Petz was always expendable and opens the Stick into a dimensional rift; Tuxedo Mask rallies the guardians, who jump in and destroy it with Sailor Planet Power (its first appearance); Sailor Moon purifies Petz and Calaveras into humans with Moon Crystal Power; Chibiusa realises Usagi holds the Silver Crystal, and so does Rubeus, watching; the four ex-sisters end the episode running a make-up stall in the Juban shopping district. ja-WP tells the same episode in Japanese twice, once under Petz ('ルベウスにダークパワーを増幅させるスティックを与えられ、カラベラスと共に人間として暮らしていたコーアンとベルチェを捕獲…セーラームーンの浄化を受け入れて人間になった') and once under Calaveras ('コーアンとベルチェが相次いで人間になった後、ペッツと共にコーアンたちを捕獲…ペッツとともにセーラームーンに浄化されて人間となった').

WHAT THE SOURCE CONTAINS AT THE SAME POINT. Renewal Act 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER: Petz runs Operation Re:New, seeds a virus through Tokyo and swaps the dead for Droids; Makoto falls ill, tells Asanuma she is a guardian, is attacked by her own double, fights Petz, is trapped in a prison of air and wind; Sailor Moon KILLS Petz with Moon Princess Halation and Rubeus carries Jupiter off in the saucer. Renewal Act 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS: the last sister Calaveras, a spirit medium, goes on television as 'Miss Calaveras' to turn the public against the guardians; Mamoru consults the Shitennou stones; Chibiusa steals Usagi's brooch; Venus fights Calaveras at the TV station while Rubeus attacks Usagi and Chibiusa and is driven off by Tuxedo La Smoking Bomber; Sailor Moon KILLS Calaveras; Chibiusa finally admits she is from the future. NOT ONE of those beats is in ep 72. No virus, no doppelganger, no Asanuma, no Jupiter capture, no TV broadcast, no seance, no Shitennou stones, no brooch theft, no Tuxedo La Smoking Bomber, no deaths. The two plots share only their OUTCOME — Petz and Calaveras leave the story — and even that outcome is inverted: sailormoon.fandom's own 'Changes from the Manga' for this episode is a single line, 'Petz and Calaveras, like their two younger sisters, were killed by Moon Princess Halation', and ja-WP says it at arc level for all four: 原作と『Crystal』では一話限りで倒されるザコ敵 … あやかしの四姉妹は全滅する, against the anime's 彼女たちはセーラー戦士に諭されてルベウスの下を抜ける道を選び、セーラームーンによる浄化で人間に戻っていく.

THE TYPING (T27/T28). Ep 72's own plot — two reformed sisters living as humans, their kidnapping by the other two, Rubeus's Stick, the rift, Sailor Planet Power, the purification, the make-up stall — is anime-original end to end; it is the resolution of an anime-original redemption arc that the source does not have. Zero standing in the source = FILLER (T27). It is not mixed: T28 needs source material present and story-carrying, and there is no source SCENE here at all, only two element-level echoes — the sister-to-guardian pairing the manga establishes (ja-WP: 長女ペッツはセーラージュピター…次女カラベラスはセーラーヴィーナス…) and the direction of the Petz/Jupiter power clash (Act 17: 'their energies collide, with Petz as the victor'; ep 72: Dark Thunder overpowers Sparkling Wide Pressure) restaged in a different place, for a different reason, with a different weapon and a different ending. Under the SLIVER CLAUSE that material is a sliver: it carries neither a type nor an anchor, it is noted, and the note names where the chapters are really adapted (Act 17's abduction lands at ep 73, stored END 17 [START 15]; Act 15-18's serial abductions are already covered by the stored block annotation abridged{15-18} on eps 70-74). The SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION is tested and FAILS BOTH HALVES: (i) the pages are not unique to this episode — Act 17 is the stored END of ep 73 and Acts 15-18 are inside the 70-74 abridged block; (ii) the beat quoted here (one power clash) is not a major plot point of the source — the major points of Acts 17-18 are the two deaths and the Jupiter abduction, and ep 72 animates none of them. This also reads consistently against the neighbours the catalog already types mixed: eps 70 and 71 restage a recognisable source CONFRONTATION (Koan infiltrating Rei's world and fighting Mars, Act 15; Berthier challenging Ami to chess, Act 16 — ja-WP describes the anime's chess-tower variant explicitly), while ep 72 restages nothing.

THE ANCHOR (A1/A44). None. A1 forbids an anchor on a filler row; A44 refuses it independently because there is no first-time source position in the episode to record. Nothing is stranded by the refusal: Act 16 stays on ep 71, Act 17 stays on ep 73, and Act 18 is where it already was (unanchored — see the flag). No continue point is deliverable either: continues attach to anchored rows, and the reader's position across this crossing is governed entirely by ep 71's END 16 and ep 73's ruled re-tread START 15.

SOURCES AND THEIR TIERS. Read directly: sailormoon.fandom via api.php (the ep-72 page, and the Act 15/16/17/18 chapter pages), en-Wikipedia 'Sailor Moon R' and 'List of Sailor Moon chapters' via api.php, ja-Wikipedia 'ブラック・ムーン一族', '美少女戦士セーラームーン' (both edition tables) and '美少女戦士セーラームーン (テレビアニメ)' via api.php. Quoted but NOT relied on as type witnesses: animefillerlist (row 72 = 'Manga Canon') and animefillerguide (row 72 unmarked) — one community lineage, arc-level here, and the catalog does not read either as a type witness. NOT AVAILABLE, recorded so the next agent does not re-spend on it: wikimoon.org (the independent Sailor Moon wiki) is Cloudflare-403 live, 403 through a text proxy, and has no Wayback snapshots of its article namespace; and there is NO licensor per-episode text for the 1992-97 series — Toei's own lineup page for 美少女戦士セーラームーンR (read via the Wayback Machine) carries staff, cast and a single series-level ストーリー and no 各話 list, and Bandai Channel does not carry the title.

anchor_hostile.why: NO ANCHOR AND NO START — the hole is real and it is empty. A1 first: this verdict retypes the row FILLER (T27 — the episode's plot has zero standing in the source), and filler rows never carry anchors. A44 second and independently: even setting the type aside there is no position to record, because ep 72 animates no page of any Act. The two acts it structurally displaces are renewal Act 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER (Petz's virus operation, the Makoto doppelganger, Jupiter trapped in a wind prison, Petz KILLED by Moon Princess Halation, Jupiter abducted) and renewal Act 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS (Calaveras the TV medium, the mass brainwashing, Chibiusa stealing the brooch, Rubeus driven off by Tuxedo La Smoking Bomber, Calaveras KILLED, Chibiusa's confession) — and ep 72 contains none of those beats. Its whole content is the anime-original Spectre Sisters redemption: the reformed Koan and Berthier raking leaves at Hikawa Shrine, Petz and Calaveras kidnapping them, Rubeus's Stick, Petz turning on her own sisters, the dimensional rift, Sailor Planet Power (a first appearance), Moon Crystal Power purifying Petz and Calaveras into humans, and the four opening a make-up stall. sailormoon.fandom's 'Changes from the Manga' section for this very episode is one line — 'Petz and Calaveras, like their two younger sisters, were killed by Moon Princess Halation' — i.e. the episode's central event is the inversion of the source's. THE SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION FAILS BOTH HALVES: the pages are not unique to this row (Act 17 is the stored END of ep 73; Acts 15-18 sit inside the stored abridged{15-18} block on eps 70-74), and the one fragment present (Petz's amplified attack overpowering Jupiter's) is not a major plot point of the source. THE CROSSING THEREFORE STANDS AS RULED: ep 71 END 16 -> ep 73 START 15 (END 17) with nothing anchorable between them; the A18 interpolation ban is correct here and the honest fill is 'no position', never a painted number. All act numbers in the 60-act renewal space (= the stored space); the same acts are 16 and 17 in the original 52-act tankobon numbering.

annotations.note: weight: SLIVER — because no source SCENE is animated; the tie is element-level only, and it is recorded so the row is not mistaken for adaptation (the same shape the catalog already uses on eps 170-172, 'Element-level carryover only'). Numbers in the 60-act RENEWAL space (= stored space): Act 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER and Act 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS; in the original 52-act tankobon numbering these are Acts 16 and 17. WHAT CARRIES OVER: (1) the source's sister-to-guardian pairing — ja-WP, 長女ペッツはセーラージュピター…次女カラベラスはセーラーヴィーナス — so the two sisters ep 72 removes are the antagonists of Acts 17 and 18; (2) the DIRECTION of one power clash — Act 17 has Jupiter attack Petz, 'their energies collide, with Petz as the victor', and ep 72 has Petz's Stick-amplified Dark Thunder overpower Sailor Jupiter's Sparkling Wide Pressure — restaged on the Rainbow Bridge against all five guardians, caused by Rubeus's Stick rather than the Dark Crystal earring, and ending in purification rather than capture. WHAT DOES NOT CARRY OVER: Act 17's virus operation (Code 003 Re:New), Makoto's illness, Asanuma, the doppelganger, the wind prison, Jupiter's abduction and Petz's death; Act 18's Miss Calaveras broadcast, the mass brainwashing, the Shitennou stones, Chibiusa's theft of the brooch, Tuxedo La Smoking Bomber, Calaveras's death and Chibiusa's confession. THE MATERIAL IS NEITHER NEW NOR SOLE: Act 17's load-bearing beat (the Jupiter abduction) is adapted at ep 73 — stored ep 73 -> END 17 [START 15] {15-17, abduction motif condensed} — and the arc-level condensation is already recorded by the stored abridged{15-18} annotation spanning eps 70-74. Act 18 is at present adapted nowhere the catalog records (see the flag on ep 73). Because the tie is a sliver it earns neither a type nor an anchor: the remainder of the episode — which is the whole episode — is anime-original, so the row is filler.

type_corrections.note: STORED canon -> PROPOSED filler. T27: the standing is measured against the source, and this episode adheres to none of it. THE POSITIVE FINDING (three independent readings of the episode agree, and none of them names a manga beat): sailormoon.fandom's scene-by-scene Plot; en-WP's summary ('Rubeus tries destroying the Sailor Guardians once and for all by giving the "Black Moon Stick" to the remaining Specter Sisters so they can kill them. In the midst, however, Chibiusa accidentally sees the girls transform…'); and ja-WP's per-character 初代テレビアニメ paragraphs for Petz and Calaveras, which retell this episode in Japanese and end セーラームーンの浄化を受け入れて人間になった. THE NEGATIVE FINDING: the source's corresponding acts (renewal Act 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER, Act 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS) consist of the virus operation, the Makoto doppelganger, the Jupiter abduction, Petz's death, the Miss Calaveras broadcast, the brooch theft, Tuxedo La Smoking Bomber and Calaveras's death — not one of which is in ep 72. ja-WP states the divergence at arc level in both directions: 原作と『Crystal』では一話限りで倒されるザコ敵だが…あやかしの四姉妹は全滅する versus the anime's 彼女たちはセーラー戦士に諭されてルベウスの下を抜ける道を選び、セーラームーンによる浄化で人間に戻っていく; and sailormoon.fandom's own 'Changes from the Manga' line for this episode is 'Petz and Calaveras, like their two younger sisters, were killed by Moon Princess Halation'. T28 is tested and does not reach mixed: mixed needs source material present and story-carrying, and the only source-shaped content here is the sister/guardian pairing and the direction of one power clash — a sliver, annotated as loose_parallel{17-18}, weightless in the standing. WHY THE STORED CANON EXISTS AND WHY IT IS NOT EVIDENCE: animefillerlist prints 'Manga Canon' on this row and animefillerguide leaves it unmarked, but both label the whole Black Moon block that way (AFG marks only 69 and 78-80 filler inside 68-84), neither cites a chapter, and the catalog does not read AFL/AFG as type witnesses — they are one lineage. CONSISTENCY WITH THE NEIGHBOURS: eps 70 and 71 are stored mixed because each restages a recognisable source confrontation (Koan against Mars, Act 15; Berthier's chess challenge to Ami, Act 16); ep 72 restages none, which is exactly the line between those rows and this one. CONFIDENCE: high on the content finding (four independent reads of the episode, three of the source acts, all agreeing); the residual risk is only that a reading of the broadcast itself might turn up a source panel none of the summaries mentions, which would at most add another sliver.

structure.notes:
1. CHAPTER SPACE — the finding that governs every number in this verdict. Sailor Moon has two act spaces and ja-WP's infobox states both: 話数 = 旧版単行本：全52話 / 新装版・完全版・文庫版：全60話. The ORIGINAL 18-volume tankobon numbers 52 acts (vol 4 = Act13 終結そして始まり, Act14 ブラック・ムーン・コーアン—SAILORMARS, Act15 ブラック・ムーン・ベルチェ—SAILORMERCURY, Act16 ブラック・ムーン・ペッツ—SAILORJUPITER; vol 5 = Act17 ブラックムーン・カラベラス—SAILORVENUS, Act18 タイムワープ—SAILORPLUTO, Act19 クリスタルトーキョー). The RENEWAL editions (新装版 2003, 完全版, 文庫版) number 60 (Act14 終結 そして 始まり, Act15 侵入—SAILORMARS, Act16 誘拐—SAILORMERCURY, Act17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER, Act18 侵略—SAILORVENUS, Act19 タイム・ワープ—SAILORPLUTO, Act20 クリスタル・トーキョー). OUR STORED SPACE IS THE 60-ACT RENEWAL SPACE: en-WP's 'List of Sailor Moon chapters' prints the renewal titles and numbers against the 18 old volumes and labels the arc 'Black Moon (volumes 4-7/chapters 15-26)'; the stored volume boundaries reproduce that table (v4 14-17, v5 18-20, v6 21-24, v7 25-27, v8 28-31, v9 32-35, v13 42-43, v14 44-46, v17 53-55, v18 56-60); and the stored anchors are only coherent there (ep 88 -> 26 再生—NEVER ENDING, ep 90 -> 27 無限1 予感, ep 199 -> 59, a number the 52-act space does not have). The census/ask phrase 'the ORIGINAL 52-act numbering' is therefore a MISLABEL of the stored space, not a second space in the data — no stored number needs converting, but the phrase should be corrected before someone acts on it. Conversion for anyone reading the original edition in this region: renewal N = original N-1 (renewal 17 秘密/JUPITER = original 16 ペッツ; renewal 18 侵略/VENUS = original 17 カラベラス); sailormoon.fandom's Act 15 page records the shift from the other side ('The original title for this chapter was Act 14 Black Moon Koan - Sailor Mars'). AniList's 61 chapters / 18 volumes is the 60-act renewal count plus one short-story unit against the old volume count — consistent with the stored space, and it also explains open flag #706 (MU's latest_chapter 12 is an edition/volume artefact, not a chapter count).

2. ROW IDENTITY. Our 200 cumulative rows, ja-WP's 72（26）form, en-WP's EpisodeNumber/EpisodeNumber3 pair and AFL's row 72 all count the same way through this block; ep 72 = R's 26th episode, 1993-10-30 on all four. No count mismatch, no shift, no date or title repair proposed. (One cosmetic wiki error, NOT ours and not a repair: sailormoon.fandom's infobox kanji field reads 非常のルベウス where ja-WP and en-WP both have 非情のルベウス.)

3. NO CHANGE TO THE CROSSING. The stored A41 ruling on ep 73 (rearranged{15-17}, the re-tread of Acts 15-17 after ep 71 reached 16) is untouched by this verdict and is in fact reinforced: with ep 72 filler, the Black Moon block's adaptation order is 68 -> 15, 71 -> 16, 73 -> 17 [15], 75 -> 19, and the only irregularity in it is the ruled re-tread.

flags_for_sean: NUMBERING LABEL — worth fixing in the census/ask text before the next wave. The line 'the Black Moon arc is Acts 15-26 in the ORIGINAL 52-act numbering' is wrong in its second half: 15-26 is the 60-act RENEWAL numbering (新装版/完全版/文庫版), which is what our anchors, volume boundaries and en-WP's chapter list all use. In the ORIGINAL 52-act tankobon numbering the Black Moon arc is Acts 14-23. Nothing in the data is wrong; the risk is that a future agent 'converts' correct stored numbers into a space we do not use. Suggested wording: 'the 60-act renewal numbering (= en-WP's chapter list and sailormoon.fandom's Act pages); the original 18-volume tankobon numbers 52 acts and runs one LOWER in the Black Moon region'.

OUT OF ASK, EVIDENCE ATTACHED, NOT PROPOSED AS A REPAIR — ep 73 may reach Act 18, and Act 18 is currently adapted nowhere in the stored map (73 -> END 17, 75 -> END 19). Renewal Act 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS opens with Chibiusa stealing Usagi's Crystal Star brooch to get at the Silver Crystal of the past (sailormoon.fandom's Act 18 page), and en-WP's ep-73 summary is 'Chibiusa, saddened and confused that Usagi is the Legendary Sailor Moon, steals the Silver Crystal and tries to go back to the future… Due to Chibiusa's meddling, Rubeus succeeds in capturing the other Guardians.' That is an Act-18 beat sitting on a row whose stored END is 17. I am NOT proposing the repair: the ask forbids touching ep 73 without pages, and what I have is two summaries, not pages. If you want it settled, the sized ask is 'ep 73: does the brooch theft come from Act 18, and does the END move 17 -> 18?' — and the same pass should ask where, if anywhere, Act 18's Calaveras/Venus material is adapted at all.

INFORMATIONAL — the stored block annotation abridged{15-18} spans eps 70-74 and therefore now sits on a filler row at 72. It is a block-level fact about the Spectre Sisters condensation and is still true of the block; I have not touched it. If the census prefers filler rows to carry only graft/partial/loose_parallel ties, the clean fix is to leave the block annotation as is and let this verdict's row-level loose_parallel{17-18} be the ep-72-specific tie.

KNOWINGLY AGAINST THE COMMUNITY LABEL — animefillerlist prints 'Manga Canon' on ep 72 and animefillerguide leaves the row unmarked. Both are arc-level judgements over the whole Black Moon block (AFG marks only 69 and 78-80 filler inside 68-84) and neither cites a chapter; the catalog does not treat them as type witnesses and treats them as one lineage. The retype rests on the episode's own content against Acts 17-18. Flagging it because the stored canon came from that label, and because the same test would probably move other rows in this block (76, 77 and 81 are the obvious candidates) — out of ask, not researched here.

DEAD ENDS RECORDED SO THEY ARE NOT RE-BOUGHT — (a) wikimoon.org, the independent Sailor Moon wiki with per-act and per-episode articles, is Cloudflare-403 live, 403 through a text proxy, and has no Wayback snapshots of its article namespace (only api.php contribution feeds); search-engine snippets of it were treated as cross-check only and are cited nowhere. (b) There is NO licensor per-episode text for the 1992-97 series: Toei's own lineup page for 美少女戦士セーラームーンR (read through the Wayback Machine) has staff, cast and one series-level ストーリー and no 各話 list, the live lineup subdomain 500s, and Bandai Channel does not carry the title. Japanese per-episode content evidence for this series therefore has to come from ja-WP's per-character 原作 / 初代テレビアニメ split (which is unusually good — it tells each Black Moon villain's story twice, once per medium) rather than from a broadcaster or licensor page.
